results.title: Maynilad septic tank cleanup to cover selected Manila barangays in August
results.description: Maynilad Water Services, Inc. will deploy desludging trucks to selected barangays in Manila this August as part of its ongoing septic tank cleaning program. Areas included in the August schedule are Port Area, Quiapo, San Miguel, San Nicolas, Sta. Cruz, and Sta. Mesa. In an advisory, the company urged residents to check whether their barangay is included in the scheduled route through announcements on Maynilad’s official website and social media pages, as well as through coordination with their respective barangay offices. Maynilad said households qualify for the service if their septic tanks have not been desludged by the company within the last five years. For barangays included in the schedule, residents do not need to book an appointment as desludging teams will conduct house-to-house operations. Meanwhile, customers whose areas are not part of the August rollout but are due for septic tank cleaning may request the service by calling Hotline 1626 or by filling out an online request form: Maynilad desludging request form . Schedules will be confirmed after processing. Maynilad said it will strictly follow its monthly barangay schedule and reminded residents to take advantage of the service once it reaches their communities. The company added that the desludging program is part of its sanitation efforts and is already covered under customers’ regular water service fees.

results.title: Akhilesh Yadav vs BJP: Akhilesh Yadav Targets BJP, Says Public Will Never Forgive Broken Promises
results.description: Samajwadi Party president and Lok Sabha MP Akhilesh Yadav launched a sharp attack on the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), claiming that the public will never forgive the ruling party for failing to fulfil its promises. In a post on X, Akhilesh said that even if the BJP offered a "dandavat" (prostration) apology, people would not forgive it because it had failed to honour its commitments to the electorate. He further alleged that the BJP's arrogance would ultimately lead to the downfall of its government. Responding to recent remarks by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Akhilesh also said that those raising questions should not be dismissed as "misguided," adding that they are fellow travellers on the path of democracy rather than people who have lost their way. His comments come amid continuing political exchanges between the Opposition and the ruling party over governance, public welfare, and accountability. The statement has intensified the ongoing war of words between the Samajwadi Party and the BJP ahead of key political developments.
